supersedes_initialisation_only: g1_piston_v3_retrain_preregistration.json. Every decision rule, threshold and reporting commitment in that document is carried over UNCHANGED. Only the initialisation differs, and the deviation is registered here in advance rather than explained afterwards.

registered_deviation.actual: warm start from the behaviour-cloning checkpoint runs/bc_sq/bc_ckpt_latest.pt
registered_deviation.reason_1: The planned checkpoint no longer exists. It was destroyed by a scratchpad wipe and is not recoverable.
registered_deviation.reason_2: The BC policy is a strictly better initialisation on the pre-registered readout itself: under the SAME v3 predicate on the SAME frozen 25-condition suite it scores reach 1.00, grasp 1.00, lift 0.80, plate 0.80, mean return 11.935, against the destroyed checkpoint's 0.20 grasp and 0.00 lift.
registered_deviation.consequence_for_H1: H1 (plateau removal raises grasp above the warm-start rate) is no longer testable as written: grasp is already 1.00 at initialisation and cannot rise. H1 is therefore RETIRED, not reinterpreted. The run tests H2 only.

what_this_run_tests.H2_dispense_is_discovery_not_imitation: The pre-registered hypothesis, now the primary one. No executable demonstration dispenses and exactly 1 of 22 shows a genuine grasped press, so any press or dispense must be discovered from reward rather than imitated. Prior expectation remains LOW.
what_this_run_tests.H4_rl_does_not_destroy_the_cloned_behavi: NEW, registered here before the data exists. Prior RL runs in this project drove grasp 0.20 -> 0.00. Starting from a competent policy, the first question is whether RL PRESERVES it. Rule: if v3 grasp falls below 0.87 (the lower bound of the initialisation's 95% CI) the run is reported as a regression, whatever happens to press and dispense.

initialisation_details_that_could_otherw.critic: REINITIALISED. A BC checkpoint has no critic. It is refitted from the replay buffer, half of which is demonstrations under RLPD. Recorded in the run config as critic_transferred=false with the reason.
initialisation_details_that_could_otherw.alpha: REINITIALISED to ALPHA_INIT; a BC checkpoint has no alpha.
initialisation_details_that_could_otherw.actor_logstd: RESET to log(0.20), NOT inherited. The BC checkpoint's 0.05 is a placeholder written at save time, not a learned exploration scale, and starting there would begin far above the alpha equilibrium -- the condition that collapsed run 3. Pinned by tests/unit_tests/test_g1_piston_policy_only_warm_start.py.
initialisation_details_that_could_otherw.why_this_matters: Each of these is a way a run could look different from run 3 for reasons unrelated to the fixes, so each is stated before the data exists.

carried_over_unchanged.reward: v3, thresholds fixed by measurement and NOT to be tuned after seeing results
carried_over_unchanged.primary_readout: v3 stage rates on the frozen 25-condition suite, deterministic, seed 20260817
carried_over_unchanged.failure_is_reportable: dispense staying 0.00 is the honest result and will be reported as such
carried_over_unchanged.post_grasp_caveat: post-grasp outcomes are not resolvable from a single evaluation; any such claim carries that caveat
